# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 48 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 39 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_048_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 48

**1** Jesus said: "If two make peace with each other in this one house, they will say to the mountain, 'Move away!' and it will move away."

---

**Translation Notes (LOGOS):**
- "Make peace with each other" — the mutual reconciliation, not merely absence of conflict
- "This one house" — the specific dwelling; the community context
- "Will say to the mountain" — future indicative; the power is consequent on the peace
- The mountain moves at a word; the power is in the reconciliation, not in the word itself
